I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
If you’re watching your budget, you’ve got a few solid options with us:
Spread the cost with Klarna on orders over £60 (Pay in 3 or in 30 days, interest-free when paid on time).
Choose lower-value gift cards (£10, £25, £50, £100) or combine a couple instead of one big spend.
For cobrand orders, remember delivery is included in the unit cost within the UK, EU and Switzerland, and we can’t process fewer than 30 units per size/color, so factor that into your per-unit budget.
You can also pick from a wide range of standard payment methods (cards, wallets, and some local methods) to use whichever fits your financial setup best.
If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
